notes.title: FULL VERSION | Get Ready for the Playtest! 🤩
notes.notes:
[h1][b]👨‍🍳 Playtest will start this week! 👩‍🍳[/b][/h1]


[h1][b] 🗓️ Mark your calendar 🗓️[/b][/h1]
[h1][u][b]November 24, 2023, at 12:00 PM CET! 🥳[/b][/u][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/


[h3]Join our culinary adventure, discover a symphony of flavors and sensations in the upcoming Playtest of the demo version![/h3]

[h3][b]Be one of the first players to receive access to the demo version - Playtess will be time-limited and access will also be limited, so sign up now to don't miss your chance![/b][/h3]

[h3][u]Sstep-by-step recipe how to sign up for the upcoming Playtest:[/u][/h3]
1. Login to your Steam account
2. Go to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/]ASMR Food Experience Steam page[/url]
3. Scroll a little lower on the page
4. You will see the banner like below 👇 and click the green button "[b]request access[/b]"
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/78bf99322d9d14e1ec8b9a73864114b3a5ee883e.gif[/img][/url]


[h2][b]In the meantime check out the newest gameplay trailer! 🔥[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=fLCxCbQXQbk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Also join us on Discord, where you can chat directly with the team and other members of our amazing community 😎[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/aZCYENsGKE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/4dadcda3a20b495658e1be8fa728a0d6b36dd7b7.png[/img][/url]

See you soon
ASMR Food Experience Team

notes.title: FULL VERSION | SIGN UP FOR PLAYTEST! 📝
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Dear Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]Right now you have the opportunity to sign up for Playtest of the demo version! 😍[/h3]

[h3]All you have to do is go to the Steam main page of ASMR Food Experience [/h3] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/

[h3]Then found the green banner you see below. 👇 Click on the "[b]request access[/b]" button and that's it![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/78bf99322d9d14e1ec8b9a73864114b3a5ee883e.gif[/img][/url]

You don't need to do anything else - [b]now just wait for the email with the invite. 📫[/b]

This is the first very important event in the production of our game, so we hope that you will be happy to join and be a part of the upcoming Playtests!

[h3]You can join us on Discord to chat directly with us and the rest of our amazing community! 😊[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/aZCYENsGKE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/4dadcda3a20b495658e1be8fa728a0d6b36dd7b7.png[/img][/url] 

See you soon!
ASMR Team
